## Description

Please include a summary of the change, related issue, and design context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing

### Automated Checks

- [ ] `cargo check` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` succeeds

### Visual Check (UI changes only)

- [ ] Verified light/dark mode styling consistency
- [ ] Check responsive breakpoints on mobile/desktop widths
- [ ] Embed screenshot/recording if applicable:

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the styling and formatting guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (CHANGELOG/README) accordingly
- [ ] My changes generate no new compile warnings
